fuel_visibility: Show the first N slots for a display count from 0 to 3. Inventory capacity and count mapping must be decided by gameplay. Do not loop or randomize stock changes.
fire: No flame geometry, smoke, light, particles or fire animation included. Attach future effects to Fire_Anchor. Embers are optional colored geometry, not emissive VFX.
burn_logs: Burn_Logs is a separate static hearth-log module, not part of the storage count.
integration: Art only, not imported into Unity. See README.md.
